all_fields.description:
Custom tags to associate with this backfill. They are applied to the backfill job and
forwarded to the underlying compute as Databricks resource tags, so backfill cost can be
attributed in the billing system tables. These tags apply only to the backfill compute; they

methods.name: CreateMaterializationSet
methods.description: Create a materialization set.

required_fields.name: materialization_set
required_fields.description:
The materialization set to create. Supply materialization_set_id to choose the identifier;
leave it unset to have one assigned.

required_request_body_fields.name: materialization_set
required_request_body_fields.description:
The materialization set to create. Supply materialization_set_id to choose the identifier;
leave it unset to have one assigned.

request_body_field.name: materialization_set
request_body_field.description:
The materialization set to create. Supply materialization_set_id to choose the identifier;
leave it unset to have one assigned.

all_fields.name: materialization_set
all_fields.description:
The materialization set to create. Supply materialization_set_id to choose the identifier;
leave it unset to have one assigned.

all_fields.name: request_id
all_fields.description:
Idempotency token for the request. A second request carrying a token that has already been
used returns the operation the first one created, whatever state it reached, and creates no
second set. The token is not checked against the rest of the request, so reusing one for a
different set returns the original operation rather than an error. Omit it and each request
creates its own set.

all_fields.name: materialization_set_id
all_fields.description: Server-assigned unique identifier for the materialization set.

all_fields.name: materialized_features
all_fields.description:
The materialized features in this set. Order is not significant.
Updating the set with a materialized feature removed from this set will cause it to be deleted.

all_fields.description:
The ID of the budget policy used to attribute the serverless compute cost of this
materialization. If not specified, a default budget policy may be applied.

all_fields.name: cron_schedule_trigger
all_fields.description: A cron-based schedule trigger for the materialization pipeline.

all_fields.name: feature_name
all_fields.description: The full name of the feature in Unity Catalog.

all_fields.name: is_online
all_fields.description: True if this is an online materialized feature. False if it is an offline materialized feature.

all_fields.name: job_id
all_fields.description: The ID of the job that materializes the feature. This is present for both batch and streaming features.

all_fields.name: last_materialization_time
all_fields.description:
The timestamp when the pipeline last ran and updated the materialized feature values.
If the pipeline has not run yet, this field will be null.

all_fields.name: latest_backfill_operation
all_fields.description: Name of the latest backfill operation on this materialized feature. Format: operations/{operation_id}.

all_fields.name: materialization_set_id
all_fields.description:
The materialization set this materialized feature was created for, through DABs or
direct-engine creation. Unset for a materialized feature that was not created as part of a set.

all_fields.name: materialized_feature_id
all_fields.description: Server-assigned unique identifier for the materialized feature.

all_fields.name: notifications
all_fields.description:
Notification configuration around the materialization job or pipeline lifecycle. They are
applied to every job and pipeline that materializes this feature. Features which are
materialized in the same pipeline will share the same notification.

all_fields.name: offline_store_config
all_fields.description:
Destination for writing feature values to an offline Delta table. The resulting table is
returned as `table_name`.

all_fields.name: online_store_config
all_fields.description:
Destination for writing feature values to an online Lakebase table. The resulting table is
returned as `table_name`.

all_fields.name: pipeline_id
all_fields.description: The ID of the pipeline that materializes this feature. This is only present for streaming features.

all_fields.name: pipeline_schedule_state
all_fields.description:
The schedule state of the materialization pipeline.
Hidden from GraphQL: being deprecated, so not exposed to Catalog Explorer.

all_fields.name: streaming_mode
all_fields.description:
The Structured Streaming trigger mode used for materialization. Real-time mode (RTM) targets
sub-second latency for operational workloads; micro-batch mode (MBM) favors cost efficiency
for ETL and analytics workloads.

all_fields.name: table_name
all_fields.description: The fully qualified Unity Catalog path to the table containing the materialized feature (Delta table or Lakebase table). Output only.

all_fields.name: table_trigger
all_fields.description: A trigger that fires when the upstream source table changes.

all_fields.name: tags
all_fields.description:
Custom tags to associate with this materialization. They are applied to the materialization
job (for batch features) or pipeline (for streaming features) and forwarded to the underlying
compute as cluster tags, so materialization cost can be attributed in the billing system
tables. These tags apply only to the materialization compute; they are not applied to the
Unity Catalog Feature resource itself, whose tags are managed separately through the Unity
Catalog tagging API. A maximum of 25 tags is supported; keys and values are subject to the
same limitations as cluster tags.

required_positional_arguments.name: feature_name
required_positional_arguments.description: The full name of the feature in Unity Catalog.

all_fields.name: excluded_columns
all_fields.description:
Column paths (dot notation, e.g. "value.email" for Kafka) to drop.
A path may reference a struct, in which case all of its nested fields are dropped (e.g. "value.address" drops "value.address.city" and "value.address.zip").
These columns are not written to the ingestion table and cannot be referenced by any feature.
They are dropped from ingestion, backfill, and materialization.
For direct schemas, each column must exist in the relevant key or payload schema. With a schema registry, a column can be excluded before it exists.
A column cannot also be a deduplication column in the ingestion_config.

Events that do not match are not written to the ingestion table and are not used in materialization.
Example: "value.event_type = 'transaction'".

Delete a materialization set and every materialized feature in it. The set is gone afterwards,

idempotent.

used returns the operation the first one created, whatever state it reached, and deletes
nothing further. The token is not checked against the rest of the request. Omit it and each
request deletes independently.

methods.name: PurgeFeatureEntities
methods.description: Purge materialized feature values for specified entities.

required_fields.name: features
required_fields.description:
Fully qualified names of the features to purge. At least one nonempty feature name is required.
A request may contain at most 500 features; submit additional features in separate requests.
Duplicate features are rejected.

required_fields.name: entities_table
required_fields.description:
Fully qualified name of the Unity Catalog Delta table containing the entity keys to purge.
The table may contain a subset of each feature's entity-key columns. A partial key match
deletes all feature rows matching the provided key values. Non-key columns are rejected;
null key values are allowed.

required_request_body_fields.name: features
required_request_body_fields.description:
Fully qualified names of the features to purge. At least one nonempty feature name is required.
A request may contain at most 500 features; submit additional features in separate requests.
Duplicate features are rejected.

required_request_body_fields.name: entities_table
required_request_body_fields.description:
Fully qualified name of the Unity Catalog Delta table containing the entity keys to purge.
The table may contain a subset of each feature's entity-key columns. A partial key match
deletes all feature rows matching the provided key values. Non-key columns are rejected;
null key values are allowed.

all_fields.name: budget_policy_id
all_fields.description:
The budget policy ID, in UUID format, used to attribute the serverless compute cost of this
purge. If not specified, a default budget policy may be applied.

all_fields.name: delete_rows
all_fields.description:
If false feature values are set to null on purge but rows are not deleted. If true then the full rows containing entities are deleted. Defaults to false.
When true, the request must include every feature which shares the same `table_name` property in their MaterializedFeature.
Features from multiple tables may be included if all features materialized in each table are included.

all_fields.name: entities_table
all_fields.description:
Fully qualified name of the Unity Catalog Delta table containing the entity keys to purge.
The table may contain a subset of each feature's entity-key columns. A partial key match
deletes all feature rows matching the provided key values. Non-key columns are rejected;
null key values are allowed.

all_fields.name: features
all_fields.description:
Fully qualified names of the features to purge. At least one nonempty feature name is required.
A request may contain at most 500 features; submit additional features in separate requests.
Duplicate features are rejected.

all_fields.name: request_id
all_fields.description: Optional UUID4 idempotency token for the request.

all_fields.name: tags
all_fields.description:
Custom tags to associate with this purge. They are applied to the purge job and forwarded to
the underlying compute as Databricks resource tags, so purge cost can be attributed in the
billing system tables. These tags apply only to the purge compute; they are not applied to the
Unity Catalog Feature resources themselves, whose tags are managed separately through the Unity
Catalog tagging API. A maximum of 25 tags is supported; keys and values are subject to the same
limitations as Databricks resource tags.

all_fields.description:
The ID of the budget policy used to attribute the serverless compute cost of this
materialization. If not specified, a default budget policy may be applied.

all_fields.name: cron_schedule_trigger
all_fields.description: A cron-based schedule trigger for the materialization pipeline.

all_fields.name: feature_name
all_fields.description: The full name of the feature in Unity Catalog.

all_fields.name: is_online
all_fields.description: True if this is an online materialized feature. False if it is an offline materialized feature.

all_fields.name: job_id
all_fields.description: The ID of the job that materializes the feature. This is present for both batch and streaming features.

all_fields.name: last_materialization_time
all_fields.description:
The timestamp when the pipeline last ran and updated the materialized feature values.
If the pipeline has not run yet, this field will be null.

all_fields.name: latest_backfill_operation
all_fields.description: Name of the latest backfill operation on this materialized feature. Format: operations/{operation_id}.

all_fields.name: materialization_set_id
all_fields.description:
The materialization set this materialized feature was created for, through DABs or
direct-engine creation. Unset for a materialized feature that was not created as part of a set.

all_fields.name: materialized_feature_id
all_fields.description: Server-assigned unique identifier for the materialized feature.

all_fields.name: notifications
all_fields.description:
Notification configuration around the materialization job or pipeline lifecycle. They are
applied to every job and pipeline that materializes this feature. Features which are
materialized in the same pipeline will share the same notification.

all_fields.name: offline_store_config
all_fields.description:
Destination for writing feature values to an offline Delta table. The resulting table is
returned as `table_name`.

all_fields.name: online_store_config
all_fields.description:
Destination for writing feature values to an online Lakebase table. The resulting table is
returned as `table_name`.

all_fields.name: pipeline_id
all_fields.description: The ID of the pipeline that materializes this feature. This is only present for streaming features.

all_fields.name: pipeline_schedule_state
all_fields.description:
The schedule state of the materialization pipeline.
Hidden from GraphQL: being deprecated, so not exposed to Catalog Explorer.

all_fields.name: streaming_mode
all_fields.description:
The Structured Streaming trigger mode used for materialization. Real-time mode (RTM) targets
sub-second latency for operational workloads; micro-batch mode (MBM) favors cost efficiency
for ETL and analytics workloads.

all_fields.name: table_name
all_fields.description: The fully qualified Unity Catalog path to the table containing the materialized feature (Delta table or Lakebase table). Output only.

all_fields.name: table_trigger
all_fields.description: A trigger that fires when the upstream source table changes.

all_fields.name: tags
all_fields.description:
Custom tags to associate with this materialization. They are applied to the materialization
job (for batch features) or pipeline (for streaming features) and forwarded to the underlying
compute as cluster tags, so materialization cost can be attributed in the billing system
tables. These tags apply only to the materialization compute; they are not applied to the
Unity Catalog Feature resource itself, whose tags are managed separately through the Unity
Catalog tagging API. A maximum of 25 tags is supported; keys and values are subject to the
same limitations as cluster tags.

all_fields.name: excluded_columns
all_fields.description:
Column paths (dot notation, e.g. "value.email" for Kafka) to drop.
A path may reference a struct, in which case all of its nested fields are dropped (e.g. "value.address" drops "value.address.city" and "value.address.zip").
These columns are not written to the ingestion table and cannot be referenced by any feature.
They are dropped from ingestion, backfill, and materialization.
For direct schemas, each column must exist in the relevant key or payload schema. With a schema registry, a column can be excluded before it exists.
A column cannot also be a deduplication column in the ingestion_config.

all_fields.name: record_type_filter
all_fields.description:
Optional SQL predicate to filter which record types from a streaming channel (e.g. a topic for Kafka) belong to this Stream.
Events that do not match are not written to the ingestion table and are not used in materialization.
Example: "value.event_type = 'transaction'".
